snippet.title: MISTER SCARY - Official NES Game Trailer | calgames
snippet.description:
MISTER SCARY, a purple monster, has lost his family. Make your way through the creepies and crawlies of a strange land to find them! A new halloween-themed platforming game for the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES).

• Conquer 6 scary stages, each with their own sub-areas.
• Defeat 6 different scary bosses.
• Stomp on your enemies! Or… eat a scary spicey or icy snack to torch or freeze your foes.
• When ducking, Mister Scary takes a nap and becomes immune to damage. You will use this often as a tactic.
• Scary tokens are everywhere. Collect 15 and earn an extra life! This will come in quite handy.
• A scary world map guides you through your adventure.
• Scary game soundtrack by Logan E. Schad and Kevin Van Der Burg.
• Directly inspired by a toddler’s imaginary friend, and brought to life by calgames.

Follow us on Instagram (calgames.nes), as well as Bluesky (calgames.us) and Twitter/X (@lancasterphotog) in order to receive the most up-to-date information about MISTER SCARY and our other titles!

WEB: https://www.calgames.us 
INSTAGRAM: https://www.instagram.com/calgames.nes
